claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-assisted Individual Case Safety Report causality assessment MUST map to a named Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance with the prescribed authority before the case is finalised. ICSRs lacking QPPV sign-off are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Every material AI-assisted safety-signal detection or signal-validation decision MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding owner identity, the GVP module obligation discharged, and the Authority Finality outcome.

Every AI-assisted action that creates, modifies, or signs a GxP electronic record MUST satisfy FDA 21 CFR Part 11 integrity controls — an attributable electronic signature bound to the record and a tamper-evident audit trail.

Every AI-assisted clinical-trial action that accepts, classifies, or remediates a protocol deviation MUST map to a named investigator or sponsor delegate with the prescribed authority under ICH E6(R3) Good Clinical Practice.
